sections.title: Rewritten in Rust
sections.description: The Undaunted Launcher has been rewritten in Rust, with a much smaller installer.

list: Existing Electron launchers can update directly, retaining valid saved logins, game folders and language settings.
Automatic signed updates remain available, with verification before installation.
Includes the updated game runtime DLL with the Undaunted private server credits.
Removed the preview branding and enabled production updates.
